---
title: "08_patchiness"
output: html_document
---
```{r load packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(vegan)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(dunn.test)
```

```{r Load data}
data_all <- read.csv(file.path("..", "data", "cleaned", "data_all.csv"))
```

```{r}
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# HELPER: variable name recoder
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

recode_vars <- function(x) case_match(x,
  "bareground" ~ "Bare ground",
  "sand"       ~ "Sand",
  "soil"       ~ "Soil",
  "herb"       ~ "Herb cover",
  "woody"      ~ "Woody cover",
  "vegheight"  ~ "Veg height",
  "sloped"     ~ "Sloped",
  "flat"       ~ "Flat",
  "steep"      ~ "Steep",
  "hill_q0"    ~ "Floral richness",
  .default = x
)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 1. SELECT FOCUSED HABITAT VARIABLES
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

hab <- data_all %>%
  select(
    patchiness,
    bareground, sand, soil,
    herb, woody, vegheight, flat,
    sloped, steep,
    hill_q0
  ) %>%
  drop_na()

cat("Complete rows for PCA:", nrow(hab), "\n")
cat("Patchiness distribution:\n")
print(table(hab$patchiness))

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 2. PCA — habitat vars only, patchiness passive
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

hab_vars   <- hab %>% select(-patchiness)
patchiness <- hab$patchiness

pca_result  <- prcomp(hab_vars, scale. = TRUE, center = TRUE)
pca_summary <- summary(pca_result)
print(pca_summary)
screeplot(pca_result, type = "lines", main = "Scree plot")

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 3. BIPLOT coloured by patchiness
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

var_exp    <- pca_summary$importance[2, 1:2] * 100
pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x[, 1:2])
pca_scores$patchiness <- as.factor(patchiness)

arrow_scale <- 3
loadings <- as.data.frame(pca_result$rotation[, 1:2]) %>%
  rownames_to_column("variable") %>%
  mutate(
    PC1s  = PC1 * arrow_scale,
    PC2s  = PC2 * arrow_scale,
    label = recode_vars(variable)
  )

p_biplot <- ggplot(pca_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, colour = patchiness)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 2.5) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("0" = "#d73027", "1" = "#fc8d59",
               "2" = "#91bfdb", "3" = "#4575b4"),
    name = "Patchiness"
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = loadings,
    aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1s, yend = PC2s),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
    colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.6,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = loadings,
    aes(x = PC1s, y = PC2s, label = label),
    colour = "grey15", size = 3.2,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    box.padding = 0.4
  ) +
  labs(
    x     = paste0("PC1 (", round(var_exp[1], 1), "% variance)"),
    y     = paste0("PC2 (", round(var_exp[2], 1), "% variance)"),
    title = "PCA of habitat variables — patchiness as passive variable"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12)

print(p_biplot)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 4. ENVFIT — patchiness as env vector
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

ef <- envfit(
  ord          = pca_result$x[, 1:2],
  env          = data.frame(patchiness = patchiness),
  permutations = 999
)
print(ef)

ef_coords <- as.data.frame(scores(ef, display = "vectors")) * arrow_scale
ef_coords$variable <- rownames(ef_coords)

p_biplot +
  geom_segment(
    data = ef_coords,
    aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1, yend = PC2),
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.3, "cm")),
    colour = "black", linewidth = 1,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = ef_coords,
    aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = "Patchiness"),
    colour = "black", size = 3.8, fontface = "bold",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(title = "PCA with patchiness fitted as environmental vector (envfit)")

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 5. SPEARMAN CORRELATIONS
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

cor_results <- hab_vars %>%
  summarise(across(everything(),
                   ~ cor(.x, patchiness,
                         method = "spearman",
                         use    = "complete.obs"))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(),
               names_to  = "variable",
               values_to = "spearman_rho") %>%
  mutate(variable = recode_vars(variable)) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(spearman_rho)))

print(cor_results)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 6. KRUSKAL-WALLIS
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

kw_results <- hab_vars %>%
  summarise(across(everything(),
                   ~ kruskal.test(.x,
                                  g = as.factor(patchiness))$p.value)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(),
               names_to  = "variable",
               values_to = "KW_pvalue") %>%
  mutate(
    sig      = case_when(
      KW_pvalue < 0.001 ~ "***",
      KW_pvalue < 0.01  ~ "**",
      KW_pvalue < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE              ~ "ns"
    ),
    variable = recode_vars(variable)
  ) %>%
  arrange(KW_pvalue)

print(kw_results)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 7. DUNN POST-HOC for key variables
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

key_vars <- c("hill_q0", "bareground", "vegheight", "herb", "woody")

for (v in key_vars) {
  cat("\n── Dunn test:", recode_vars(v), "──\n")
  dunn.test(hab_vars[[v]],
            g      = as.factor(patchiness),
            method = "bonferroni",
            kw     = TRUE)
}

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 8. SUMMARY TABLE
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

summary_table <- left_join(cor_results, kw_results, by = "variable") %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(spearman_rho)))

print(summary_table)

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# 9. BOXPLOTS
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────

hab %>%
  select(patchiness, all_of(key_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-patchiness,
               names_to  = "variable",
               values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(
    patchiness = as.factor(patchiness),
    variable   = recode_vars(variable)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = patchiness, y = value, fill = patchiness)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.size = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("0" = "#d73027", "1" = "#fc8d59",
                               "2" = "#91bfdb", "3" = "#4575b4")) +
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x     = "Patchiness score",
       y     = "Value",
       title = "Habitat variables by patchiness score") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
